description: This file defines the LDAPSyncException class, a custom exception class used within the LDAP authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to LDAP synchronization errors, such as non-unique emails, length constraints, and missing attributes.

classes.name: LDAPSyncException
classes.description: A custom exception class for LDAP synchronization errors, providing static factory methods for various specific error conditions.

methods.name: nonUniqueWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee work email is not unique.

methods.name: nonUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee ID is not unique.

methods.name: userDNMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the User DN exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: usernameMinLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username is shorter than the minimum length.

methods.name: usernameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: usernameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the first name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the first name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: middleNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the middle name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: lastNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the last name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: lastNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the last name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: employeeIdMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the employee ID exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: employeeWorkEmailMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the employee work email exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: invalidEmployeeWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception for an invalid employee work email.
